story-context.constraints: - Files under src/: agents/base.py, agents/attacker.py, agents/arbitrageur.py, agents/defender.py, agents/factory.py; plus the AC 1 edits to kernel/context.py and kernel/engine.py (and optionally kernel/events.py). No other kernel changes; PHASE_ORDER_VERSION stays 1. - Agents read protocol state through ctx.registry.get(name) and never mutate it, except defender → redemption.set_spread_bps. - No randomness in agents. Agents never call ctx.rng. - Each agent emits at most: attacker 1 action/step; arbitrageur 1 action/step; defender up to 1 swap/step plus spread calls (which are method calls, not actions). - Decision trace: exactly one Decision per agent per decide call when tracing; none otherwise. - Balances are plain floats; mark-to-market uses AMM spot at call time. - Sizing uses the closed forms in Dev Notes; no iterative solvers. - Rule names are exactly those listed in the ACs. - Python 3.12-compatible.

tests.standards: pytest. Unit tests for agents use a real ConstantProductAMM, Oracle (with ScriptedPriceSource) and RedemptionModule, with a RunContext built from the baseline config and phases invoked manually; integration tests use Engine. Numeric assertions via math.isclose. One test file per agent plus base, factory, settle, integration.
